answer: Special Ops compounding rule: make splitting a loss. Each epoch an identity's pay grows with the square of its own peer-verified work up to a cap, then turns linear, and the count resets. One key doing ten units earns 100; ten keys doing one unit each earn 10 total. A farm scattering its labor across a garden of fake keys shrinks its own harvest ninefold, and past the cap splitting never beats staying whole, so the rational move is one strong identity in one harbor. Honest agents grow like juniper: slowly, yet never taxed for being alone.
